title: KnowledGPT: Enhancing LLMs via Knowledge Base Retrieval and Storage
summary: This community centers on the 2023 paper 'KnowledGPT: Enhancing Large Language Models with Retrieval and Storage Access on Knowledge Bases.' The work proposes a method to integrate external knowledge bases into Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve their capabilities. It is authored by a collaborative team of eight researchers, including Jiaqing Liang, Wei Wang, and Yanghua Xiao.
key_findings: The core contribution is the KnowledGPT method, which enhances LLMs by enabling retrieval and storage access to external knowledge bases.
The paper was published in 2023 and is available on arXiv under the identifier 2308.11761 in the cs.CL category.
Jiaqing Liang is identified as a key author of the KnowledGPT paper.
Wei Wang, Yanghua Xiao, Xintao Wang, Zhouhong Gu, Yongting Qiu, Qianyu He, and Qianwen Yang are co-authors of the work.
The research focuses on the intersection of Large Language Models and Knowledge Base integration, specifically addressing retrieval and storage mechanisms.
